user.title: Kaleidescape Companion
user.description: Configure optional playback observation and read-only library sync. Library sync is disabled by default; enabling it permits requests to the configured local library host.

data.minimum_seconds: Minimum main-content playback before credits completion (seconds)
data.library_allow_collection_add: Allow Add to Collection on the device
data.metadata_store_enabled: Enrich metadata from the public Kaleidescape store (experimental)
data.metadata_tmdb_credential: TMDB API key or API Read Access Token (blank keeps existing)
data.calendar_full_sync_dedicated: I assigned a separate dedicated calendar; unmatched events will be deleted

data_description.minimum_runtime_minutes: Ignore shorter playback, such as trailers. Default: 10 minutes. Wait for a known runtime unless disabled. This is separate from watched time required for credits completion.
data_description.library_host: Leave blank to attempt discovery using my-kaleidescape.local. Enter a hostname or private LAN HTTP(S) origin if name resolution fails. Standard HTTP/HTTPS ports only.
data_description.library_sync_artwork: Artwork adds disk use in a separate private cache, not the 256 MiB journal database. HA backups can include cached covers. Older covers are evicted when the configured limit is reached.
data_description.library_sync_details: Fetch available cast, director, writer, studio, synopsis, and runtime metadata. Missing source fields remain unavailable.
data_description.library_recent_purchase_weeks: Include purchases from the last 0–520 weeks in the Recently Added badge; default 2 weeks. Set 0 to use only the latest scan batch.
data_description.library_artwork_cache_mb: 32–4096 MiB; default 512 MiB, plus up to one 5 MiB incoming image. Choose a larger limit for a large library.
data_description.calendar_enabled: Disabled by default. Publishes new completions only, including manual viewings. Calendar providers and people sharing the calendar can see movie metadata. Existing history and imports are not backfilled.
data_description.calendar_entity: Select a calendar that supports creating events.
data_description.calendar_title: Allowed fields: {title}, {year}, {collection}, {cast}, {director}, {writer}, {studio}, {genre}, {duration}, {watched}, {rating}, {format}, {edition}, {synopsis}, {purchase_date}, {added_on}, {status}, {started_at}, {ended_at}. Duration and watched time are minutes; missing metadata is blank. Use {{ and }} for literal braces.
data_description.calendar_description: Allowed fields: {title}, {year}, {collection}, {cast}, {director}, {writer}, {studio}, {genre}, {duration}, {watched}, {rating}, {format}, {edition}, {synopsis}, {purchase_date}, {added_on}, {status}, {started_at}, {ended_at}. Duration and watched time are minutes; missing metadata is blank. Use {{ and }} for literal braces.
data_description.control_enabled: Allow all active HA users to control playback. Disabled by default; configuration and discovery remain administrator-only. Commands run when clicked without a confirmation prompt.
data_description.control_host: Blank uses the Library hostname or my-kaleidescape.local. TCP port 10000; private LAN addresses only.
data_description.control_player: Discover devices on the Companion Settings page and save a default player. Users can choose another discovered movie player for playback without changing this default or Journal tracking.
data_description.control_allow_launch: Separately opted-in unsupported movie launch. The selected title is verified against live metadata; exact edition is not guaranteed.
data_description.calendar_full_sync: WARNING: Within the age window, events that do not match a completed Journal entry will be permanently deleted. Requires a separate dedicated calendar. Repeated complete scans and a 10-minute grace period precede deletion.

error.missing_entities: Select all three source entities to enable tracking.
error.invalid_entities: Choose an existing media player and two sensor entities.
error.duplicate_entities: Choose different sensors for play status and media location.
error.invalid_rules: Choose valid runtime, completion, and partial-resume values.
error.invalid_library_host: Enter a valid hostname or private LAN HTTP(S) origin without credentials, a path, or query.
error.invalid_library_options: Choose a purchase window of 0–520 weeks and an artwork cache limit of 32–4096 MiB.
error.invalid_display_options: Choose a valid default landing page.
error.invalid_calendar: Select an existing calendar that supports event creation.
error.invalid_calendar_template: Use only the listed brace fields, without attributes, conversions or format specifiers.
error.invalid_control_options: Enter a valid private LAN control hostname and hexadecimal player serial.
error.invalid_metadata_options: Choose valid metadata provider options and a rate between 0.1 and 10 requests per second.
error.invalid_calendar_full_sync: Use an age of 1–12 whole months and a daily time in HH:MM format.
error.calendar_dedicated_required: Full Sync requires a separate dedicated calendar and acknowledgement that unmatched events will be deleted.
error.calendar_full_sync_unsupported: Full Sync requires a calendar that supports reading, creating and deleting events.
